messages.subject: Low LOD threshold
parts:
Hi,

I've been running scanone with proportion phenotype (arcsine-squareroot transformed), weighted by total events (successes + failures):

out<-scanone(reduced_data, pheno = proportion, weights = total_events)  

The individuals are from a backcross.

When I run operm I get a surprisingly low 0.05 threshold at lod = 2.3. With every other phenotype I normally get a threshold of ~3 (including proportion data treated in the same way). 

Is this something I should worry about?

Many thanks,

Richard

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Low LOD threshold
parts:
Yes, that's very strange and I would want to figure out what's causing the low threshold.

karl
